subject: English Home Language

source.subtopic: Recognises different spellings of the same sound: tie, high, sky; few, blue

show.line: Tie, high, sky. One sound, three spellings. Few and blue, same sound, two spellings!

rounds.prompt: Which word has the same sound as sky?
Which word has the same sound as blue?
This word rhymes with high. You switch it on when it is dark. What is it?
Tap the word that spells night the right way.
Sounds like sky, or sounds like blue? Sort the words.
Which word has ew, as in few?
Tap the word that does not have the same sound. Tie, high, hat.

hints: Listen to the vowel sound. Does it sound like sky or like blue?
igh, ie and the letter 'y' can all say the same sound.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will find a word that sounds like blue.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Bell has a short e. Glue sounds like blue.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's listen together. Blue, glue, few, new. Same sound!

parent_line: Can hear the sounds in sky and blue and knows their spellings.
